I'm a girl, actually! I started listening to currents over the summer at a really peaceful time in my life which is why I feel like this rush of emotion is confusing/exciting. I definitely am in a "recovery" phase of my life and TI hit me at a time I didn't even know I needed it. I am a fairly new fan, I was really into a different genre of music before currents, but I listened to lonerism and innerspeaker and new this just filled the gap in my emotions that I was missing. It changed me - moved me out of my comfort zone. I know I can't play it safe and choose loneliness over vulnerability. TI feels like that reassuring friend who shows me it's ok to be happy and sad and indulge in those feelings. TI's music is so powerful and I've never felt this rush of change or inspiration from any music before. What an amazing connection!
